fixture_contract.name: blg-d12-cache-control-two-candidate-v1
fixture_contract.reset: For each HTTP case recreate only its isolated namespace from versioned immutable A/B web images and manifests. For each browser group create a fresh persistent profile, warm A at one stable origin, atomically switch fixture routing to B, capture evidence, then remove only that profile/namespace. Never clear cache or storage mid-case, disable cache, change origin, use a live/prod resource, or allow external egress.
fixture_contract.planned_executor: production-image HTTP verifier plus Playwright browser fixture

coverage.requirement: AC01 FF entry aliases/fallback GET and HEAD no-cache
AC01 seller entry aliases/fallback GET and HEAD no-cache
AC02 referenced hashed asset immutable and manifest-bound
AC03 HTML and non-hashed asset are not immutable
AC04 ordinary warm-cache A to B browser proof
AC05 changed stale validator returns B; identical current entry may 304
AC06 retained A asset retrieval and URL-byte immutability
AC07 missing/redirect/error cannot prove entry or asset
S14 complete immutable B inventory, including transitive chunks, CSS imports, fonts and images; reject immutable URL outside inventory or manifest

cases.title: FF root, index and client fallback serve no-cache after representation resolution
cases.fixture: A/B FF entries and one FF client route
steps: Request /, /index.html and an FF client route with GET and HEAD against B.
cases.expected: Every successful response is the FF entry representation and has exactly Cache-Control: no-cache for both methods; status/final URL/body identity are recorded.
cases.read_back: All aliases have B entry digest.
cases.reload_assertion: A normal browser reload may revalidate these responses.

cases.title: Redirect, error, duplicate header or unrelated fallback cannot pass as entry proof
cases.fixture: B with redirect/error probes and outer conflicting-header variant
steps: Request redirect, missing HTML, and conflicting-header paths with GET and HEAD.
cases.expected: Redirect/error/unrelated body and duplicate or contradictory Cache-Control values fail the case even when one token is no-cache.
cases.read_back: Recorded status, final URL, body digest and full header distinguish every rejected response.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: rejected response cannot establish a reload result.
cases.oracle: S11 proof boundary; S13 A4; S14 outer-header attack.

cases.title: Seller root, index and client fallback receive the same no-cache contract
cases.fixture: A/B seller entries and one seller client route
steps: Request /seller/, /seller/index.html and a seller client route with GET and HEAD against B.
cases.expected: Each successful seller entry representation has exactly Cache-Control: no-cache and B's seller entry digest.
cases.read_back: No seller alias retains an alternate cache policy.

cases.title: Referenced content-addressed asset is immutable and matches B manifest
cases.fixture: B entry, referenced hashed JS and CSS, complete B inventory
steps: Fetch selected referenced hashed JS/CSS with GET and HEAD using Accept-Encoding: identity.
Compare URL and bytes with B manifest.
cases.expected: Each selected asset is referenced by B entry, has exactly public, max-age=31536000, immutable, and digest equals B manifest.
cases.read_back: Manifest entry, URL and response digest form one B identity chain.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload may safely reuse identical URL/bytes only.

cases.title: HTML and non-hashed public asset never receive immutable one-year policy
cases.fixture: B entry HTML and non-hashed asset under /assets/
steps: Fetch both with GET and HEAD.
Inspect full effective Cache-Control values.
cases.expected: Neither response contains immutable one-year policy; directory membership does not classify the non-hashed file as immutable.
cases.read_back: Response class and digest are recorded separately from hashed inventory.
cases.reload_assertion: Entry remains revalidatable rather than immutable.

cases.title: Ordinary A-warmed browser navigation reaches B entry and B bundle
cases.fixture: Persistent profile, stable origin, distinct A and B entries/manifests/build identities
steps: Open A normally and record A entry, loaded assets and visible build identity.
Switch same origin to B without cache/storage reset.
Use ordinary open or normal reload.
cases.expected: Navigation revalidates entry and visibly reaches B build identity with B manifest-linked bundle URL; no missing asset, mixed entry/bundle, console error or failed request occurs.
cases.read_back: Post-navigation normal reload remains on B and records navigation plus loaded script/style URLs.
cases.reload_assertion: Hard reload is captured only after this ordinary-path pass as supporting evidence.
cases.oracle: S11 operator outcome; S13 warm-cache proof.

cases.title: Cold profile, cache clear, disabled cache or hard reload cannot satisfy warm-cache proof
cases.fixture: A/B stable origin with controlled browser modes
steps: Attempt the A-to-B observation with a cold profile, cleared storage, cache disabled, and hard reload first.
cases.expected: Each shortcut is labeled non-primary evidence and cannot pass D12-C1-06.
cases.read_back: Harness records profile identity, origin, navigation type and cache mode.
cases.reload_assertion: Only an ordinary navigation from a persisted A-warmed profile is eligible.
cases.oracle: S11 required downstream proof; S14 browser-false-pass attack.

cases.title: A stale validator receives B body when entry bytes changed
cases.fixture: A and B with distinct entry bytes and A validator
steps: Send A If-None-Match or equivalent validator to B entry aliases.
cases.expected: Every changed B entry returns its current body, never an invalid 304 preserving A bytes.
cases.read_back: B entry digest differs from A and equals returned body.
cases.reload_assertion: Normal revalidation can advance from A to B.

cases.title: 304 is accepted only for byte-identical current entry
cases.fixture: B served twice without entry-byte change and B validator
steps: Send B validator to unchanged B entry aliases.
cases.expected: 304 is acceptable only when retained and current B entry digests are identical; otherwise test fails.
cases.read_back: Validator and B digest are retained in evidence.

cases.title: B retains A immutable assets throughout declared rollback window
cases.fixture: B manifest plus retained A inventory, source artifact digest and retention window
steps: After switch to B, GET and HEAD every retained A asset with identity encoding.
Compare bytes to A inventory.
cases.expected: Every A URL remains retrievable with recorded A bytes and manifest/source-artifact linkage through the named window.
cases.read_back: A asset inventory has no missing or changed URL.
cases.reload_assertion: An old A entry can still load its own retained bundle set.

cases.title: Effective public-origin policy has one candidate-bound header owner
cases.fixture: B image Caddy config and host-port override variants
steps: Record candidate-bound config digest.
Request public-origin FF/seller entry and asset responses through each active serving path.
cases.expected: Effective responses have one non-conflicting policy consistent with candidate-bound Caddy config; appended/replaced/contradictory outer values fail.
cases.read_back: Config digest, response headers and image digest are tied to one candidate.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: conflicting policy blocks proof before browser run.

cases.title: Missing hashed-looking asset remains 404 and cannot fall back to index
cases.fixture: B plus absent /assets/app.deadbeef.js and non-hashed inventory probe
steps: Request absent asset with GET and HEAD.
cases.expected: Missing asset is distinct 404, not 200 HTML/index; it cannot be counted as immutable inventory success.
cases.read_back: Status, body type/digest and cache header are recorded as failed proof.
cases.reload_assertion: Browser must report missing referenced asset as failure, not success.

cases.title: Mixed A/B identity, service-worker shortcut or network failure blocks browser pass
cases.fixture: A/B identity mismatch, optional preexisting service-worker and forced asset failure variants
steps: Run ordinary navigation under each negative variant.
Inspect visible identity, entry digest, loaded URLs, console and failed requests.
cases.expected: Any mismatched SHA/image/entry/asset/build identity, service-worker shortcut, console error or failed request fails the warm-cache case.
cases.read_back: Evidence identifies the divergent candidate field or failed URL.
cases.reload_assertion: No follow-up reload may erase the initial failure.
cases.oracle: S11 exact-artifact proof; S14 identity-chain attack.

cases.title: Same hashed URL with different bytes fails candidate assembly and retention proof
cases.fixture: B collision variant reusing one A hashed URL with altered bytes
steps: Attempt to build/verify B retained inventory against A inventory.
cases.expected: Candidate fails before promotion; no response with the reused URL can be accepted as A or B proof.
cases.read_back: Collision report contains URL and unequal digests without treating either as retained success.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: invalid candidate cannot be navigated as pass evidence.
cases.oracle: S11 content-addressed URL invariant; S13 A3.

cases.title: Complete current B immutable inventory is manifest-bound, including transitive chunks, CSS imports, fonts and images
cases.fixture: B candidate manifest, static URL-to-digest inventory and import graph containing direct entry assets, lazy chunks, CSS imports, fonts and images
steps: Derive the complete B immutable URL set from the candidate manifest and recursively resolved JS/CSS import graph, including emitted fonts and images.
Enumerate every current B response served with immutable caching using GET and HEAD with Accept-Encoding: identity.

For every immutable response, require exactly one matching URL and digest in the derived set and candidate manifest; for every derived immutable URL, require a successful immutable response with the recorded bytes.
cases.expected: The current B immutable response set and the candidate-manifest-derived inventory are exactly equal. Every direct or transitive chunk, CSS import, font and image has exactly public, max-age=31536000, immutable and bytes equal to its recorded digest.
cases.read_back: Evidence records candidate manifest digest, derived import edges, complete immutable URL set, GET/HEAD status and full Cache-Control, plus each response digest; a non-immutable manifest member is recorded separately and cannot be silently counted as immutable.
cases.reload_assertion: A browser may reuse only the URL/byte pairs proven by this inventory; this HTTP case alone does not prove warm-cache navigation.
cases.oracle: S14 complete-inventory constraint; S13 A2; S11 hashed-asset policy.

cases.title: Immutable B URL absent from candidate inventory or manifest fails closed
cases.fixture: B negative variant with a served immutable direct or transitive chunk, CSS-imported font/image, or other static URL deliberately omitted from the candidate manifest/inventory
steps: Derive the expected B immutable URL set exactly as D12-C1-15.
Request the omitted immutable URL with GET and HEAD using Accept-Encoding: identity.
Run complete-inventory comparison and require the mismatch to fail before any candidate or browser proof is accepted.
cases.expected: Any immutable B response absent from the candidate manifest-derived inventory is a hard failure even when its filename looks hashed, its bytes are readable, and its Cache-Control is otherwise correct.
cases.read_back: Failure evidence names the URL, response digest, full Cache-Control, missing manifest/inventory membership and the import edge or static-serving path that exposed it.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: a candidate with an unbound immutable URL cannot be used for browser or release evidence.
cases.oracle: S14 complete-inventory attack lane; S13 A2 fail-closed inventory rule.

audit_focus: All S12 AC01-AC07 and S14 attack lanes have direct plus breaker coverage.
Every case has deterministic non-production fixture/reset and S19 binding.
Warm-cache proof cannot pass cold cache, hard reload, cache clear, origin change or service-worker shortcut.
No case broadens scope into deploy, prod, secrets, API, auth, tenant, database, worker, print or marketplace work.
